integrity_note: Analytical theorem with independently executable exact-rational finite checks; no exhaustive literature-priority guarantee and no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two symmetric interacting followers and one fixed-opinion leader
Three or four synchronous broadcasts with a fixed intervening silence budget
Strictly positive unequal follower-specific broadcast weights and p between zero and one half
Only final consensus of the followers is optimized
Concentration inequality is sufficient but not asserted necessary for integer schedules
title: Exact four-broadcast scheduling and a concentration regime in a two-follower opinion network
